title: http3: Don't point to file scoped memory after leaving the scope
description:
If we have allocated a (file-scoped) decoder, then we might make the
global header string point to file scoped memory while processing.
Make sure that header string points to NULL instead when leaving
the file scope (which happens when the decoder is destroyed.)

It doesn't seem like both cache maps are used currently, and really
there should be only one cache map with the same keys. The current
implementation works but is brittle.

Fix #19399


(cherry picked from commit f15c7ee1354d7ba51ea6e6579897e8fdcdfb7b87)
